title: Fiery Punk Sorceress
description: A fierce female character with voluminous, wild magenta and red hair stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears a red and gold outfit with a cropped top, short shorts, a utility belt, and tall red platform boots, while casting glowing pink and purple energy orbs from both hands.
prompt: A fierce young woman with extremely voluminous, wild flowing magenta and red hair stands in a powerful stance with legs apart. She has dramatic makeup and an intense expression.
